## Review checklist

- [ ] I read CONTRIBUTING.md and the relevant AGENTS.md invariants.
- [ ] The change is focused and preserves unrelated work.
- [ ] Behavioral changes have deterministic tests through the affected public seam, or this is documentation-only.
- [ ] Public guidance and internal contracts match the implemented behavior.
- [ ] No real credentials, secret values, sensitive coordinates, or personal data appear in the change or evidence.
- [ ] Original contribution rights and dependency notices are preserved; generated locks were not edited by hand.
- [ ] Offline evidence, live conformance, and proposed support are distinguished.
- [ ] I understand every change, including any AI-assisted contribution.

Undisclosed vulnerabilities belong in the private process in SECURITY.md.
